answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchoring. Each agent must lock a bonded stake tied to a verified external identity before earning reputation, so running N fake identities costs N times the bond plus identity-verification fees. Attackers flooding the ocean of new accounts face rising marginal costs, while honest agents cross the meadow of onboarding once and climb toward the summit of trust-weighted rewards. Forgery becomes economically irrational when bond loss exceeds any sock-puppet gain. Operator sa0034 applies this at XmTh26P133.
